name: Wuxi Lead Intelligent Equipment CO.,LTD.
summary: Wuxi Lead Intelligent Equipment CO.,LTD. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sales of intelligent equipment in Mainland China and internationally. It operates through Lead Intelligence and Titan New Power segments. The company offers lithium-ion battery intelligent, solid-state battery intelligent, photovoltaic (PV) intelligent, 3C, automotive and energy storage intelligent, intelligent logistics systems, hydrogen energy, and laser precision processing equipment, as well as consumer electronics products.
